name: Shramik Parivahan Yojana (GBOCWWB)
benefit:
1. Under the scheme, registered construction workers will receive a bus pass at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace.
   1. Under the scheme, the beneficiary is required to contribute 20% of the pass amount, while the board covers the remaining 80%.

_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be engaged in any Building or Other Construction Work.
   1. The construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
